set.body: Goal: populate, certify, and publish the release-bound EyeLink validation artifact using the deterministic generator and completed vendor court. Acceptance criteria: permitted EDF Access API and vendor EDF2ASC results populate every claimed support-matrix cell; release generation runs from a clean identified source revision; hosted verification recomputes the artifact; unsupported configurations and missing vendor evidence remain explicit; public aggregate evidence exposes no private gaze content; artifact SHA-256 and scientific digest are recorded in the completion note. This bead makes the support claim; generator implementation is tracked separately.
set.title: Certify and publish the release-bound EyeLink validation artifact
